clauses.current_legal_basis: Held current text of 8 U.S.C. 1440(a) (U.S. Code release point 119-121) still keys the end of the Vietnam period to a date designated by the President by Executive order, and the Code prints EO 12081 as a note under 8 U.S.C. 1440 with no ending statement; the bounded eCFR search as of 2026-10-14 and the Federal Register disposition-note search found no revocation or amendment.
clauses.reason: The paragraph deems the statutory period of Vietnam hostilities that began on February 28, 1961 to have terminated on October 15, 1978 for purposes of ending the period of active-duty service that qualifies for the naturalization exemptions. It has no expiry or condition, no held later order revokes or amends it, the statute it rests on is in force and still refers to a date designated by Executive order, and the Code prints the order as current, so it was operative on 2026-10-14.

research_rationale:
EO 12081 (Carter, signed 1978-09-18, 43 FR 42237, published 1978-09-20) orders, under section 329 of the Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1440) and section 3 of the Act of October 24, 1968, that the statutory period of Vietnam hostilities that began on February 28, 1961 shall be deemed to have terminated on October 15, 1978, for the purpose of ending the period in which active-duty service qualifies for the exemptions from the usual naturalization requirements. The authority statute is in force: the held current text of 8 U.S.C. 1440(a) still provides that the Vietnam period runs from February 28, 1961 to the date designated by the President by Executive order as the date of termination of the Vietnam hostilities, and the Code prints this order as a note under 8 U.S.C. 1440 with no ending statement. The order has no own-terms end, the Federal Register disposition notes list no amendment or revocation, and the eCFR search found no hit. The designation is a standing legal fixing of the statutory period's end date (the date October 15, 1978 is the date fixed, not a date on which the order ends), so the clause is recorded as continuing.

savings.reason: The order fixes a standing date that the statute keys to; nothing in the held sources ends or amends it, so no residual exists beyond the operative clause. Naturalizations completed on service before October 15, 1978 are governed by the statute itself.
